about_the_game:
What’s the dumbest thing three guys can do at a bar?

  • Easy. Pick one of them as the “sacrifice” to hit on a girl!

  • So, who's our lucky sacrifice?

  • It's you. Yeah, 

Pumped up by his friends, Kutay decides to make his move on Ayşil, one of the bar’s new regulars.

While Kutay’s approach is anything but innocent, you can bet Ayşil isn’t exactly innocent either!

The night starts with their encounter, but from there, who knows where it’ll lead? Kutay might end up discovering things about himself, seeing sides of the city he never knew existed, and realizing that sometimes, people are more than just people.

He could find himself in a fight with strangers, caught between two emotions, or screaming his head off. Sometimes, he can’t take his eyes off someone, other times, he’s risking it all.

But isn’t that what love’s always like, in a way?

On this wild ride of a night, Kutay’s got only one friend by his side: you!

FEATURES

  • A dynamic story progression driven by player choices.

  • Over 150 decisions to make.

  • A dice mechanic that adds an element of luck to your choices.

  • Character customization options, allowing for multiple playthroughs.

  • 4K resolution visuals.

  • Real-time, directed action scenes.

  • A story map you can track.

  • Every choice impacts the "love meter."

Will you help Kutay navigate the dangers of romance and fear to reach a happy ending, or will your choices lead him to a darker fate? Dive into "Love: Fall in Death" and explore a narrative where every decision counts.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains sensitive content such as infrequent use of profanity, alcohol, blood, occasional violent actions, and depictions of injury, and may not be suitable for all age groups.
